## Description
The names of the student appearing for February 2026 exam is visible even now. Their names appearing till January 2025 is okay. The students once they write University Exam and Pass then they no longer will be in Second year. Further in March 2026 a NEW set of students will enter into Second year as the New February 2027 exam appearing students. Solution appreciated - Removing the name of February 2025-2026 students from Name list and either adding New February 2026-2027 students names OR considering the February batch students as a new entity. Thank you Sir.
